questions.statement: I sit on a ________ to watch TV.
questions.context: Learning about furniture in English class.

options.feedback: A sofa is the long padded seat where a family sits to watch TV.
A bed is where you sleep, so you lie on it, not sit on it to watch TV.
A fridge is a kitchen appliance for keeping food cold, not something to sit on.
A stove is used for cooking food; it is not a seat.

This question evaluates remember skills regarding furniture at the CEFR A1 level.
